note: Answer keys for the Housing SEPP rule pipeline (docs/sepp-rule-pipeline.md §6, step 10). Each case is a lot and a land use with the answer the instrument gives, the clause it rests on, and what the hand-built lmr catalogue (/api/lmr/types) says. A disagreement with the lmr catalogue is allowed only when `lmrDisagrees` explains it with a clause. Written 2026-10-07.

cases.name: Bambara: R2 outside every LMR catchment, on Parramatta's Dual Occupancy Prohibition 'D' land
cases.lmrDisagrees: s 166 permits dual occupancies 'on land to which this chapter applies in Zone R2'; s 164 makes that the whole State less (a)-(m) - not only the LMR area. The lmr catalogue requires the LMR area for permissibility (known error, progress file baseline).

R3 outer LMR area in the Georges River catchment - s 164(1)(f) flood prone land undecided
cases.lmrDisagrees: s 164(1)(f) excludes flood prone land in the Georges River and Hawkesbury-Nepean catchments. The lot is inside the Georges River catchment and flood prone land is not held, so whether Ch 6 reaches it is undecided; lmr.lot_lmr records no exclusion and no undecided item for this lot and says eligible.
